senses.gloss: m. (סָפַר), pl. סְפוּרִים, סְפוּרִין the days which have to be counted (Lev. XV, 28), legal calculation.
units: <cite ref="Niddah 30a:15">Nidd. 30ᵃ</cite> <he>שלימו לה ס׳ דידה</he> her account is completed.

<cite ref="Niddah 30a:17">Ib.</cite> <he>בעינן ס׳ בפנינו</he> we (the judges) require the count before us, i.e. we count from the first day of her appearance before the ritual court; <cite ref="Niddah 69a:28">ib. 69ᵃ</cite>
